open-flow

    Dictate anywhere on your Mac. Nothing leaves it.

    • Hold the Option key, speak, release — the text appears where your cursor is.
    • Speech recognition and cleanup run on your Mac with Whisper and a small local model. No account, no cloud.
    • Setup: two macOS permissions, one automation consent, and a one-time download (1–3.7 GB).

    Permissions

    Microphone checking… Records your voice only while you hold Option.
    Accessibility checking… Lets open-flow notice when you hold Option and paste with ⌘V. It does not read what you type.
    Automation checking… Lets open-flow ask System Events to press ⌘V. macOS will ask you once.

    Granted permissions turn green automatically — no need to come back and click anything.
